MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

4. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/4
   D. 1/2

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 49

6. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22

   C. 16
   D. 32

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)

   A. 19.6
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31

   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 20
   C. 30
   D. 75

16. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 8

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
